title: Error message during eros Pod activation
body:
Hello everyone, once again I had problems with an eros pod activation this night.
Deactivation of the Pod went very well. When activating the new Pod, after transferring the basal rate to the Pod, I got the following error message 'Checking activation step failed. Please try again'.
I then tried again, but this also failed with the same message.
I then cancelled the activation and tried again with the same Pod. The screen then immediately jumped to telling me to attach the pod to my body, which I did and the activation went through without a problem. Pod tab looked good afterwards and pump ran immediately without error.
Attached is a screenshot and the log file from the activation at 01:16 tonight.

Hardware:
Samsung Galaxy A40 Android 11
AAPS 2.8.2.14-dev Build: 057d072e8
OL FW 3.2
![Bild1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/59526802/145672849-70ff2903-cb17-43ba-a2cb-e519406ccabd.jpg)
[AndroidAPS._2021-12-11_00-57-03_.2[1].zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/7696792/AndroidAPS._2021-12-11_00-57-03_.2.1.zip)

Greetings Thomas
